heading: G6_Applying Unitary Method in Different Real-Life Situations

topics.heading: Applying Unitary Method in Different Real-Life Situations

question: Look at the unitary method diagram shown above. Which mathematical operation is used to find the value of one single unit when you already know the total value of multiple identical units?

Look at the unitary method diagram shown above. Once you have calculated the value of one single unit, which mathematical operation is used to find the total value of a required number of identical units?
A pack of 8 identical water bottles costs $32. What is the cost of 1 water bottle?
A local junior football club buys 9 identical soccer balls for a total of $135. The cost of 1 soccer ball is $______.
At a weekend farmers' market, 4 mangoes cost $3.60. What is the cost of 1 mango?
At a neighbourhood bakery, 6 glazed doughnuts cost $4.80. What is the cost of 1 glazed doughnut?
6 identical watercolour paint sets cost $48. Using the unitary method, what is the total cost of 11 such paint sets?
A tour group pays $112 in total for 8 identical science museum entry tickets. At the same ticket price, 5 entry tickets will cost $______.
At a fruit shop, 4 large oranges cost $3.40. How much will 9 identical oranges cost?
At a stationery shop, 5 identical packs of sticky notes cost $8.75. At the same rate, 8 packs of sticky notes will cost $______.
One dozen chocolate cupcakes cost $48 at a patisserie. What is the cost of 14 chocolate cupcakes at the same rate?
Two dozen passionfruits cost $16.80 at a fruit market. At this exact rate, 20 passionfruits will cost $______.
7 identical plastic document folders cost $28. How many of these folders can be bought for $52?
At a local bakery, 9 identical sausage rolls cost $27. With a budget of $54, a cricket team manager can buy ______ sausage rolls.
Look at the two supermarket packs of identical muesli bars shown above. Which pack offers the better value for money (cheaper cost per bar)?
options: Pack A, because $6.50 is a smaller total price.
Pack B, because each bar costs $1.20 compared to $1.30 in Pack A.
Pack A, because each bar costs $1.20 compared to $1.30 in Pack B.
Both packs offer the exact same value per bar.

question: Look at the two multi-packs of identical iced tea bottles shown above. Which pack is the better buy (cheaper cost per bottle)?
options: Pack X, because each bottle costs $2.30 compared to $2.40 in Pack Y.
Pack Y, because larger multi-packs are always cheaper per bottle.
Pack Y, because each bottle costs $2.20 compared to $2.30 in Pack X.
Both packs cost the exact same amount per bottle.

question: A coach bus travels 280 km in 4 hours at a constant speed. Travelling at this same constant speed, how far will the bus travel in 9 hours?
A hybrid car uses 15 litres of petrol to travel 240 km. Using petrol at the exact same rate, the car can travel ______ km on 25 litres of petrol.
A scone recipe uses 480 grams of flour to make 16 identical scones. How many grams of flour are needed to make 25 scones?
A cycling club organiser packs 720 grams of dried apricots for 18 cyclists. Keeping the exact same portion size per cyclist, the organiser needs ______ grams of dried apricots for 30 cyclists.
Ethan earns $144 for working 8 hours at a community swimming centre. At the same hourly pay rate, how much will he earn for working 13 hours?
Ruby earns $126 for spending 7 hours tutoring younger primary students. At the same hourly rate, she will earn $______ for 15 hours of tutoring.
At a wholefoods store, 500 grams of roasted cashews costs $8.50. What is the cost of 3 kilograms of the exact same cashews?
A small 200 mL jar of pure bush honey costs $2.80. At the exact same rate per millilitre, 2.5 litres of this honey will cost $______.
5 gardeners working at the same steady speed take 8 days to landscape a community park. How many days will 4 gardeners take to landscape the exact same park?

9 builders working at the same steady rate take 10 days to construct a timber deck for a community hall. Working at the same rate, 15 builders will take ______ days to construct the exact same timber deck.
